title: Oil Hits a Five-Month High as Gulf Risks Mount
en: Brent crude climbed to its highest level in more than five months on Friday as attacks on Saudi energy facilities and fresh incidents in the Strait of Hormuz stoked fears of further supply disruption from the Middle East. Brent briefly touched $114.72 a barrel, its strongest since May, while US crude rose 2.56% to $102.02. By the close, Brent settled 3.13% higher at $116.72 and WTI gained 3.92% to $103.27. Yemen's Houthi movement has intensified strikes on Saudi infrastructure and Red Sea shipping lanes, and Iran's Revolutionary Guard said two supertankers hit mines south of the strait. Higher crude has lifted European natural gas prices and revived inflation worries.
zh: 周五，布伦特原油升至五个多月来的最高水平。沙特能源设施遇袭、霍尔木兹海峡接连发生新事件，加剧了外界对中东供应进一步中断的担忧。布伦特原油盘中一度触及每桶114.72美元，为5月以来最强；美国原油涨2.56%至102.02美元。收盘时，布伦特涨3.13%至116.72美元，WTI涨3.92%至103.27美元。也门胡塞武装加大了对沙特基础设施和红海航运通道的打击，伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队称两艘超级油轮在海峡以南触雷。油价走高推升了欧洲天然气价格，并重新点燃通胀担忧。
vocab: v. 激起，煽动（情绪、担忧）

title: Wall Street Ends a Rocky Week as the AI Trade Wobbles
en: US stocks fell on Friday, closing a turbulent week driven by doubts about heavy artificial-intelligence spending. The Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 1.23% to 52,215.16, the S&P 500 lost 0.52% to 7,623.68 and the Nasdaq Composite slipped 0.21% to 25,955.34. For the week, the S&P 500 fell 0.47% and the Nasdaq 0.71%, both a second straight weekly decline, while the Dow added 0.41% for a third weekly gain. American Express sank 3.68% after saying it would cut about 5% of its global workforce to become ready for AI. The Federal Reserve is expected to hold rates steady next Wednesday.
zh: 周五美股下跌，为这个因质疑巨额人工智能支出而动荡的一周画上句号。道琼斯工业平均指数跌1.23%至52215.16点，标普500指数跌0.52%至7623.68点，纳斯达克综合指数跌0.21%至25955.34点。全周看，标普500指数跌0.47%、纳指跌0.71%，均为连续第二周下跌；道指则上涨0.41%，实现连续第三周上涨。美国运通大跌3.68%，此前公司表示将裁减约5%的全球员工，以为全面迎接人工智能做好准备。市场普遍预计美联储将在下周三的会议上维持利率不变。
vocab: adj. 动荡的，波动剧烈的
phr. 维持不变，保持稳定

title: France Braces for Protests as Bond Yields Spike
en: France will deploy around 70,000 police and gendarmes nationwide on Saturday to contain a fresh round of protests over the rising cost of living, a week after the country saw its worst unrest in years. President Emmanuel Macron has postponed planned visits to Nigeria and Senegal and convened his defence council. The turmoil has unnerved investors. French government bonds suffered a historic sell-off this week, with the ten-year yield touching 5.1415% intraday, the highest since 2002, while Moody's placed the sovereign rating under review. French purchasing managers' surveys also fell below the 50 line in October, weighed down by fiscal and political uncertainty.
zh: 法国将于周六在全国部署约7万名警察和宪兵，以遏制因生活成本上升引发的新一轮抗议活动；一周前，该国刚刚经历多年来最严重的骚乱。总统马克龙已推迟对尼日利亚和塞内加尔的访问计划，并召集国防委员会会议。这场动荡令投资者不安。本周法国国债遭遇历史性抛售，10年期收益率盘中触及5.1415%，为2002年以来最高，穆迪同时将法国主权评级列入审查。法国10月采购经理人调查也全线跌破50的荣枯线，受财政与政治不确定性拖累。

title: Moscow and Kyiv Agree a Local Ceasefire Ahead of Talks
en: Russia and Ukraine have agreed to a temporary halt in military operations around Oleshky in the Kherson region, allowing humanitarian supplies to enter and civilians to leave through designated safe corridors, the White House said on Friday. Russia's chief of the general staff, Valery Gerasimov, said Russian forces would stop firing and observe a silence regime in the Kherson direction from 4 a.m. Moscow time on October 27. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov added that trilateral talks on security guarantees involving Russia, the United States and Ukraine will begin in Abu Dhabi in the first half of November, and European participation has not been ruled out.
zh: 白宫周五表示，俄罗斯与乌克兰已同意在赫尔松地区奥列什基周边暂时停止军事行动，以便人道主义物资进入，并安排平民通过指定的安全通道撤离。俄罗斯武装力量总参谋长格拉西莫夫表示，俄军将自莫斯科时间10月27日4时起在赫尔松方向停止开火并实行静默状态。克里姆林宫发言人佩斯科夫补充说，俄、美、乌三方关于安全保障问题的谈判将于11月上半月在阿布扎比启动，未来也不排除欧洲方面参与。
vocab: n. 静默状态（停火安排）

title: Japan's Core Inflation Finally Clears the 2% Bar
en: Japan's core consumer price index rose 2.1% year on year in September, exceeding the Bank of Japan's 2% target for the first time this year and reinforcing expectations that policymakers will keep tightening. People familiar with the matter said the central bank judged earlier rate increases had done limited damage to the economy and may move again as soon as December. The contrast with other major economies is striking. Euro zone composite purchasing managers' index eased to 51.9 in October, with French activity contracting, while the United States held at a robust 57.6. Russia's central bank left its key rate at 14% for a second meeting.
zh: 日本9月核心消费者价格指数同比上涨2.1%，今年以来首次超过日本央行设定的2%目标，强化了决策者将继续收紧政策的预期。知情人士称，日本央行判断此前加息对经济冲击有限，最快可能在12月再度行动。与其他主要经济体的对比相当鲜明：欧元区10月综合采购经理人指数降至51.9，法国经济活动陷入收缩；美国则维持在57.6的强劲水平。俄罗斯央行则连续第二次会议维持14%的基准利率不变。
vocab: n. 核心消费者价格指数

title: China's AI Chipmakers Move From Trials to Scale
en: Chinese AI chipmakers are moving from pilot deployments to large-scale commercial delivery, and competition is shifting from single-chip benchmarks to whole-system capability. Cambricon reported third-quarter revenue of 3.531 billion yuan, up 104.47% from a year earlier, and net profit of 1.404 billion yuan, a 147.74% increase, citing wider adoption in finance and internet workloads. Baidu says its Kunlunxin P800 has lit up a 32,000-card cluster on the company's AI computing platform, while Alibaba's T-Head unit says the Zhenwu M890 processor now serves more than 650 external customers across 20 industries. IDC expects shipments of AI accelerators in China to grow 19% in 2026.
zh: 中国人工智能芯片企业正从试点部署迈向规模化商业交付，竞争焦点也从单颗芯片的跑分指标转向整体系统能力。寒武纪发布的三季报显示，第三季度营收35.31亿元，同比增长104.47%；净利润14.04亿元，同比增长147.74%，公司称增长得益于金融、互联网等场景的更广泛采用。百度表示其昆仑芯P800已在该公司AI计算平台上点亮3.2万卡集群；阿里巴巴旗下平头哥称真武M890处理器已服务20多个行业的650多家外部客户。IDC预计，2026年中国AI加速器出货量将增长19%。
vocab: n. 工作负载，运算任务
